commands.command: cargo clippy -- -D warnings -D unsafe_code -D clippy::unwrap_used -D clippy::expect_used -D clippy::panic -D clippy::indexing_slicing -D clippy::as_conversions -D clippy::arithmetic_side_effects

rules_satisfied: No lossy as cast - replaced payload.len() as u32 with u32::try_from(payload.len())
max_payload parameter is now enforced - returns PayloadTooLarge when payload exceeds limit
Smallest change: only added bounds check and checked conversion in encode_frame
Clippy clean with strict lint flags
residual_risk: None - payload length is checked against max_payload before any allocation, lossy cast removed with checked conversion, FrameError::Overflow available for pathological payloads exceeding u32::MAX
